# Output variables and code inventory

This unified reference brings together the raw model output writer calls,
the physical source arrays, and the postprocessed NetCDF variable names and
units declared by `scripts/srv2nc` and `plasim/doc/variable_list.txt`.

Rows indicate numeric Service code, variable short name, full descriptive name,
declared physical units, Fortran source array or mathematical expression, vertical
level argument, and the writer routine or postprocessor. All five model output
streams are documented: atmospheric output (`plasim_output`), sea ice (`ice_output`),
mixed-layer ocean (`ocean_output`), LSG deep ocean (`lsg_output` and `LSG_srf`),
and derived/postprocessed diagnostics.

Code 333 denotes atmospheric header metadata, and dynamic code ranges (such as
user diagnostics `ndiaggp`/`ndiagsp`, and entropy diagnostics) are discussed in {doc}`output`.

## LSG deep ocean

Source: {repo}`lsg/src/lsgmod.f90` (`outpostsrv` writing `lsg_output` on unit 93
and `outsurf` writing `LSG_srf` on unit `nopost`).

Note: In raw Service records, LSG writes negative field codes (`jcode < 0`)
to distinguish ocean fields from atmospheric GRIB codes. Postprocessors and `srv2nc`
map them to the positive codes (1–99) shown below.

## Postprocessed and derived variables

Source: {repo}`scripts/srv2nc` and postprocessing afterburners.

These quantities are derived or interpolated from raw model fields by conversion
tools (such as spectral wind synthesis from vorticity/divergence, sea level pressure,
vertical coordinate interpolation, or energy/water budget sums).
